shots.words: In nineteen sixty-eight, a 3M chemist tried to make an extremely strong glue, and failed.
shots.draw: 1960s lab: a big painted bottle labelled ADHESIVE, Silver at the bench pressing two wooden blocks together
shots.moves: slow push; on 'failed' the top block drops off

shots.words: Spencer Silver had made the opposite.
shots.draw: Silver in profile, closer, looks down at the block in his hand

shots.words: A glue so weak, you could peel it off and stick it back again.
shots.draw: Insert: a paper slip on a plain wall peels off and sticks back, twice
shots.moves: peel and stick on the words

shots.draw: Office: Silver holds out the bottle, a colleague walks past without looking

shots.words: For five years, he showed it to anyone who'd listen.
shots.draw: Same office: colleagues walk past one after another, Silver keeps holding out the bottle; painted year tags tick 1968 to 1973
shots.moves: walkers cross, arm lifts each time

shots.words: Then a colleague, Art Fry, had a problem in church.
shots.draw: A church: stone wall, a pew; Fry stands holding a red hymn book
shots.moves: Fry walks in, opens the book

shots.words: His paper bookmarks kept falling out of his hymn book.
shots.draw: Insert: the open hymn book, paper slips slide out and fall

shots.words: So he coated them in Silver's weak glue.
shots.draw: Insert: a yellow paper slip; a knife spreads a strip of glue along its top

shots.words: They stayed, and they peeled off clean.
shots.draw: The hymn book open, a yellow slip stuck to the page; it lifts off clean

shots.words: But the first time 3M sold them, in four cities, they flopped.
shots.draw: A shop counter with a pyramid of small boxes; a shopper walks past without looking
shots.moves: shopper crosses; on 'flopped' the top box tips over

shots.draw: Insert: one box, the label PRESS 'N PEEL

shots.words: In nineteen eighty, they came back as Post-it Notes.
shots.draw: The plain wall: yellow notes bloom across it, one after another

shots.words: He was trying to make glue that never lets go.
shots.draw: Back to the lab: Silver presses the blocks together again

shots.words: It's on your fridge because it always does.
shots.draw: A kitchen: a cream fridge covered in yellow notes; one drops and is stuck back
